questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The speed of sound is maximum in which of the following media?
questions.explanation: Sound travels fastest in solids because of their high elasticity, and it cannot travel through vacuum at all.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.topic: System of Particles and Rotational Motion
questions.question: The moment of inertia of a thin uniform rod of mass M and length L about an axis passing through its centre and perpendicular to its length is:
questions.explanation: For a rod about its central perpendicular axis I = ML²/12. About one end it becomes ML²/3 by the parallel axis theorem.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 6: System of Particles and Rotational Motion

questions.subject: Physics
questions.topic: Dual Nature of Radiation and Matter
questions.question: In the photoelectric effect, the maximum kinetic energy of the emitted photoelectrons depends on:
questions.explanation: Einstein's equation KEmax = hν - φ₀ shows the maximum kinetic energy rises with frequency; intensity only changes the number of photoelectrons.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 12, Chapter 11: Dual Nature of Radiation and Matter

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: In the reaction Zn + CuSO₄ → ZnSO₄ + Cu, zinc behaves as:
questions.explanation: Zinc goes from 0 to +2, that is it is oxidised, and in doing so it reduces Cu²⁺ to Cu. The species that is oxidised is the reducing agent.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The unit of the rate constant for a first order reaction is:
questions.explanation: The unit of k is (mol L⁻¹)^(1-n) s⁻¹. For n = 1 this becomes simply s⁻¹, independent of concentration units.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Which of the following halides undergoes an SN1 reaction most readily?
questions.explanation: SN1 proceeds through a carbocation, so the rate follows carbocation stability: 3° > 2° > 1° > methyl halide.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 12, Chapter 6: Haloalkanes and Haloarenes

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: Which of the following is the lowest or most basic category in the taxonomic hierarchy?
questions.explanation: Species is the basic unit of classification; a group of related species forms a genus, related genera form a family and so on upwards.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 1: The Living World

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: According to NCERT, the net gain of ATP from the complete aerobic oxidation of one molecule of glucose in a eukaryotic cell is:
questions.explanation: Glycolysis, the Krebs cycle and the electron transport system together give a net gain of 36 ATP per glucose molecule in eukaryotes.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 12: Respiration in Plants

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Insulin is secreted by which cells of the islets of Langerhans?
questions.explanation: Beta cells secrete insulin, which lowers blood glucose, while alpha cells secrete the opposing hormone glucagon.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 19: Chemical Coordination and Integration

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: The bond that links two amino acids together in a protein chain is a:
questions.explanation: A peptide bond forms between the carboxyl group of one amino acid and the amino group of the next with the loss of a water molecule.
